mapper.sql: u.USER_ID AS userId, u.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, u.NAME_ENC AS nameEnc, u.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, u.WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, (SELECT MAX(a.ALT_SCORE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY a.ASSESSED_AT, a.ASSESSMENT_ID) FROM ASSESSMENT a WHERE a.USER_ID = u.USER_ID) AS latestAltScore, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE AS accountStatusCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REPORT r WHERE r.POST_ID IN (SELECT p.POST_ID FROM BOARD_POST p WHERE p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID) OR r.COMMENT_ID IN (SELECT c.COMMENT_ID FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.USER_ID = u.USER_ID)) AS reportedPostCount, u.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, u.LAST_LOGIN_AT AS lastLoginAt, u.NICKNAME AS nickname

where.if: (LOWER(u.LOGIN_ID) LIKE LOWER(#{qLike}) ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(u.NICKNAME) LIKE LOWER(#{qLike}) ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM APP_USER u
ORDER BY u.USER_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED_YN FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
